page.overview:
Who is Wilibald Bolger?

Wilibald Bolger was a Hobbit of the Shire.

Wilibald was born to Theobald Bolger and Nina Lightfoot. He married Prisca Baggins. They had three children; Wilimar born in TA 2947 (SR 1347), Heribald born in TA 2951 (SR 1351), and Nora TA 2960 (SR 1360). He died in TA 3000 (SR 1400).
